title.en: An Act to Amend Sections three, Five, and Six of Act Numbered thirty-One Hundred and Eight, Entitled "An Act Creating a Public Utility Commission and Prescribing Its Duties and Powers, and for Other Purposes

text.en:
Section three of Act Numbered Thirty-one hundred and eight is hereby amended to read as
"Section 3. The Public Utility Commissioner shall receive an annual compensation of twelve thousand pesos;
the Assistant Public Utility Commissioner shall receive an annual compensation of ten thousand pesos, and
the Secretary of the Commission shall receive an annual compensation of six thousand pesos, all to be paid
monthly by the Insular Treasurer."

Section five of Act Numbered Thirty-one hundred and eight is hereby amended to read as
"'Section 5. With the approval of the Secretary of Justice, the Public Utility Commissioner shall appoint a
secretary of the Commission, an auditor, an electrical engineer, an assistant electrical engineer, a naval
engineer, two inspectors, and such other officers and employees as may be necessary, and fix their duties. The
salaries of these officers and employees, except that of the secretary of the Commission, shall be fixed by the
Public Utility Commissioner, with the approval of the Council of State."

Section six of Act Numbered Thirty-one hundred and eight is hereby amended to read as
"Section 6. The secretary of the Commission shall perform such duties as may be required of him; he shall be
the official reporter of the proceedings of the Commission, and shall have authority to administer oaths in all
matters coming under the jurisdiction of the Commission."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 6, 1924.
